text:
maria: quick security check — onboarding partner-archive for model artifacts. They want us to allow outbound to two IPs from prod VPC. Our preferred approach is VPCE + deny internet egress, but partner says they only serve from fixed IPs. Can sec sign off on adding 35.199.12.5/32 and 35.199.12.6/32 to the egress allowlist for the artifacts subnet? Also need guidance on redacting S3 object keys from access logs.

alex: do we know why they can’t use an S3 VPCE or a signed presign flow? is this cross-cloud storage or a proxy layer?

maria: partner runs a GCS-backed CDN fronting artifacts at those IPs, cross-account setup. They require https on 443 to those endpoints only. No other ports.

sam: (sec) _short answer_: we prefer routing through our outbound proxy + VPCE where possible. If you must add IPs we need: 1) business justification ticket, 2) tight egress SG rules (443 only) and CIDR /32, 3) NACL entries to match, 4) a 30d temporary access window with review. Also we need log-redaction in place before prod.

maria: agreed. i'll open a ticket with justification and SLA. in the meantime here's a minimal SG egress snippet we plan to propose to infra: 
```yaml
SecurityGroupEgress:
  - IpProtocol: tcp
    FromPort: 443
    ToPort: 443
    CidrIp: 35.199.12.5/32
  - IpProtocol: tcp
    FromPort: 443
    ToPort: 443
    CidrIp: 35.199.12.6/32
```

sam: that SG looks fine for the allowlist slice. Important: redact S3 object keys from access logs (don't store full path). Ops should add a Fluentd/Vector filter that replaces s3.object_key with "<REDACTED>" before storage. Also add a note to the incident runbook about rotating the allowlist after window expiry.

sec-bot: new access request created: REQ-2026 — status: pending review (link: https://redwood.prod/requests/REQ-2026)

tara: approving conditioned: dev environment = approved for 30d. prod requires architecture signoff + PR with justification and cert fingerprint. For logs: add redact regex and a sample rule in infra: 
`filter {
  if [s3] { mutate { gsub => ["[s3][object_key]", ".*", "<REDACTED>"] } }
}`

alex: noted. i'll open infra PR with SG change, NACL, and the redaction rule. @maria can you confirm partner cert fingerprint and SLA window?

maria: will get cert fingerprint and SLA today. Opening infra PR now: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1789 — includes the SG snippet + runbook note.

sam: ack. once PR merged sec will set REQ-2026 to approved for dev; prod pending arch signoff. tagging this thread for follow-up.

maria: thanks all — looping in partner to capture cert fingerprint and will update the PR.
